concerns.text: The plan estimates a total runtime of ~‑5 hours for 800 API requests (200 snippets × 4 conditions) on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner. With a 120 s timeout per request, even with two concurrent workers the worst‑case wall‑clock time exceeds the 6 h CI limit (≈13 h). This makes the pipeline infeasible under the stated compute constraints.

The inference step relies on the HuggingFace Inference API for CodeLlama‑7B. Access to this model typically requires a paid HF token or incurs usage costs, which conflicts with the project’s “free‑tier” compute budget. The plan does not provide a free‑tier alternative or a cost‑mitigation strategy.
